query:
SELECT DATE(started_at) AS "date!",
               COUNT(*)::bigint AS "count!",
               AVG(avg_viewers)::float8 AS avg_viewers
        FROM twitch_stream_sessions
        WHERE streamer_login = $1
          AND started_at >= $2
          AND duration_seconds > 300
        GROUP BY 1
        HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
        ORDER BY 1 DESC
